{{Quote|This is my hate! This is my vengeance!|Gerlun|<ref name="Legacy 27" />}}
'''Gerlun''' was a member of the [[Malevolence (cult)|Malevolence]], a [[Sith cult/Legends|cult]] of [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] living in [[Andeddu's Keep]] on [[Prakith/Legends|Prakith]]. In [[137 ABY]], [[Darth Wyyrlok (III)|Darth Wyyrlok III]] [[Mission to Prakith (Darth Wyyrlok)|appeared]] at the Keep to learn [[Darth Andeddu]]'s secrets and use them to aid [[Darth Krayt]], the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]].<ref name="Legacy 27" /> Gerlun and his<ref name="Sony" /> fellow Dark Jedi confronted the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]]. They were no match for Wyyrlok's mastery of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and, under the influence of a [[Mind trick/Legends#Force illusion|Force illusion]], Gerlun struck down [[Demtri]]. Soon after, Darth Wyyrlok spared Gerlun but killed the rest of the group using [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]].<ref name="Legacy 27" />

Wyyrlok forced Gerlun to guide him to [[Darth Andeddu]]'s tomb. Once inside, [[Holocron of Heresies|Darth Andeddu's holocron]] tried to convince Wyyrlok to place the holocron on Andeddu's body, but Wyyrlok refused. Attempting to avenge himself on Wyyrlok, Gerlun used the Force to grab the holocron and placed it on the body. When he did, however, his life was sucked out of him and Darth Andeddu was reanimated before also being destroyed.<ref name="Legacy 27" />
